title: LP2-15 reported reverse-add palindrome: arithmetic and control
question: Does the reported 53-digit reverse-add example hold, and how often do its own digits give palindromes after shuffling?
summary: The reported 53-digit sum is a palindrome because every mirrored digit pair adds without carrying. The same operation gave a palindrome in 50,442 of 100,000 fixed shuffles of its digit multiset; this does not test the manuscript-to-digits derivation or cipher intent.

family.title: Prime-distance reverse-add claims
family.question: Which numerical claims about reported word-sum distance strings survive exact arithmetic and matched controls?

scope.representation: The exact 53-character decimal string reported for an LP2-15 word-sum-distance construction, including its leading zero; no rune or word transcription is used in this arithmetic-only replay.
scope.procedure: Add the string to its full character reversal as integers, verify all 53 paired decimal columns and carries, then shuffle the fixed digit multiset 100,000 times with seed 3301 and apply the same operation to each.
scope.parameters: One selected 53-character example; 100,000 conditional random permutations; Python random.Random seed 3301; leading zero allowed in shuffled strings.
scope.exclusions: Derivation of GP word sums and nearest-prime distances, alternative zero groupings, a complete search-adjusted p-value, plaintext recovery, and evidence of authorial intent.

finding: The quoted sum is correct and palindromic. All 53 mirrored digit-pair sums are at most seven, so no carrying occurs and symmetry is guaranteed. Of 100,000 fixed-digit shuffles, 50,442 produce palindromes under the same integer operation; all 50,442 also satisfy the no-carry condition with a nonzero outer pair.
limitations: The original decimal string and zero grouping were selected before this audit. The source-to-digits derivation has not been replayed, and the conditional shuffle is not a p-value over all available pages, segmentations and arithmetic choices. Computational review only; human review pending.
next_steps: Replay the word-level GP sums from pinned page text under explicit word boundaries, nearest-prime ties and zero handling. Enumerate every eligible section and grouping, then apply the full selection procedure to matched controls.

reproduction.environment: Python 3 standard library; no network or AI service. Run from the repository root or extracted bundle root.

review.reviewer: Codex — independent column-arithmetic check and fixed-seed computational replay; human review pending

visuals.caption: Every paired digit sum in the reported decimal string remains below the carry threshold of ten.
